summary: The `ansible.builtin.int` filter converts a value to an integer; it's Jinja's builtin int filter.
questions: How do I convert a string to an integer in a template?
What does the int filter do?

answer_card.title: int filter
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.int` converts the value into an integer. It's Jinja's builtin `int` filter.
